column1: # Endogenous peptide ligands of OPRM1 (P35372, mu-opioid receptor), curated by IUPHAR/BPS
# These are the positive controls of record for the pharmacophore screen (PLAN.md 5.1).
# pKi spans 8.1-8.5, i.e. 0.4 log units, so they are BINARY positives and cannot support
# a potency-ranking claim. See docs/validated_screening_framework.md in
# MOR_peptide_binding, where potency ranking was tested with 4.43 log units of range and
# c_term: free | amide. Endomorphin-1 is C-terminally amidated; the amide removes the
# terminal carboxylate and that changes the pharmacophore feature set, so it is recorded
# met-enkephalin (YGGFM) is listed separately: it is the TEMPLATE ligand, present as the
# N-terminal message segment of beta-endorphin in 8F7Q, and is therefore excluded from
# the recovery statistics it would otherwise trivially pass.
